h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Akola

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Akola

items.pText: In Akola, most of our playground enquiries come from schools. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Akola's schools, housing societies and municipal gardens at our factory in Vasai, about 450 km away. We deliver to Vidarbha by road and install with our own team or a dealer, either grouted into the ground or self-standing.

A school ground has a problem a society garden does not have. The same space must work for a four-year-old in pre-primary and a twelve-year-old in the senior classes. Mixing them on one structure leads to collisions and crowding. We plan school playgrounds in separate zones, with low slides, spring riders and small climbers for the youngest children and taller climbers, nets and bigger multi play systems for the older ones. Akola's summers are very hot, so we also look at where shade falls during the hours children are outside.

items.q: How should a school in Akola plan equipment for different classes?
items.a: Split the ground into zones by age. Low slides and spring riders suit pre-primary children, while primary and older children need climbers and larger structures. We mark these zones on the layout drawing.

items.q: Can school playground equipment take heavy daily use?
items.a: Our equipment is built from galvanised steel, roto-moulded plastic and composite laminates. The 3-year warranty on these parts covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as we instruct.

items.q: What do you need from us to suggest equipment?
items.a: The length and width of the space, the age groups and number of children who will use it, and a few photos. We then suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.
